cypher.description: One Cypher write: CREATE, MERGE, SET, DELETE, REMOVE or FOREACH, or a CREATE or DROP of an index or constraint. A person approves the exact statement with Neo4j's plan of it; it runs once, in one transaction.

parameters.description: Values of the statement's $parameters: strings, numbers, booleans, null, lists and maps.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
